walkthroughs.title: Get started with Orbit HQ
walkthroughs.description: Every chat, your account, usage and your whole Claude Code setup, in one sidebar. Five minutes to learn, then it just works.

steps.title: Open Orbit
steps.description:
Orbit lives in the bar on the far left: look for the planet. The icons along the top are its tabs; hover near either end to scroll through them, or press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K) to search everything. Ask Claude anything from the box on Home.
[Open Orbit](command:orbit.open)

media.altText: Orbit Home: ask Claude, what is running, where you left off, and today's usage

steps.title: Pick up any chat
steps.description:
Every Claude Code chat, newest first, with what's running live. Click one to continue right where Claude stopped, in a terminal (or Claude's chat panel: your choice in Config). Type to search, or tick “In messages” to search everything that was said.
[Show my chats](command:orbit.showChats)

media.altText: The Chats list with search and filters

steps.title: Undo anything Claude changed
steps.description:
Checkpoints lists every chat where Claude kept copies of the files it edited. Open a chat, then a file, to compare any version with now or restore it with a preview and undo. Orbit never deletes anything.
[Show checkpoints](command:orbit.showCheckpoints)

media.altText: Checkpoints: chats with the files and versions Claude kept

steps.title: Reuse your best prompts
steps.description:
Every prompt you have typed, repeats collapsed and pasted text restored. Use one again in a new chat with one click.
[Show my prompts](command:orbit.showPrompts)

media.altText: The Prompts list with use again and copy

steps.title: Your account and plan limits
steps.description:
See who's signed in and your plan. Save each Claude account you use, then switch with one click, no logging in again. Turn on plan limits to watch your 5-hour and weekly limits.
[Show my account](command:orbit.showAccount)

media.altText: Account: profile, saved accounts and plan limits

steps.title: See what you use
steps.description:
Tokens and cost by day, model and project, your streak, the tools and MCP servers Claude used, and a weekly recap.
[Show my usage](command:orbit.showUsage)

media.altText: Usage: cost per day, streaks and activity

steps.title: Set Claude up your way
steps.description:
Config changes the model, reasoning effort and permissions in plain words, with a health check. Skills, MCP, Plugins, Agents, Commands, Hooks and Memory each have a tab of their own. Every change is backed up and can be undone.
[Open Config](command:orbit.showSetup)

media.altText: Config: model, effort and permissions in plain words

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
